description: Plan a French cleat wall for a workshop with the Fredenslund cleat system: 90 mm cleat boards and 90 mm gaps (180 mm pitch), hook plate 72 mm including 12 mm material, 30 mm buffer between hangers, a 900 mm table that hangs on its own cleat one hook lower (cleat top 840) with the rows following that cleat, top cleat at least one gap below the ceiling, lowest cleat at least 210 mm above the floor (its underside; rows 300 … 2280 on the default wall). A hanger comes off by lifting it the material + 3 mm, so the hook plate is at most the gap − 3 and the top cleat at least the hook plate + 3 below the ceiling. The default wall is a full plywood sheet, 1220 × 2440 mm. Give the wall size and the hangers to hang (hooks, shelves, boxes, panels: left edge, the cleat row it hangs on, width, extra rows spanned below — a shelf usually spans one row). Returns the cleat rows (cleat top heights from the floor), every hanger with its panel height and whether it fits — and why not (row missing, row off, outside wall, collision) — the cut list with cleat metres, wall coverage, a picture of the wall (a link to a 1200 × 630 PNG) and a link that opens the same plan editable in the tool. All values in mm. Call with no hangers to get the rows for a wall first. Beta.

hangers.description: Hangers to place. Each hangs on one cleat row, given by the height of that cleat's top edge from the floor

cleat_top_mm.description: Height from the floor of the top edge of the cleat the hanger hangs on; must be one of the wall's rows (300, 480, 660, 840, 1020, 1200 … 2280 with default settings)

extension_mm.description: Extra panel length below the lowest cleat, mm (default 0)

name.description: Optional name shown on the drawing and in the cut list (max 40 characters)

rows_below.description: Extra cleat rows spanned below the hook row (0 = one cleat; each adds one pitch, 180 mm, to the panel height). Typical: hooks 0; shelves and boxes 1 (a shelf hangs on its row and rests on the cleat below); deep boxes and panels 2; tall panels 3

width_mm.description: Width in whole mm (the planner drags in 10 mm steps; the palette sizes are 50–550)

x_mm.description: Left edge, mm from the wall's left edge (x + width at most 8000, the widest wall)

rows_off.description: Cleat rows to switch off, by cleat top height from the floor

system.description: Override the Fredenslund system (all in mm). Leave out to use the defaults

board_mm.description: Cleat board height (default 90). The gap equals the board unless gap_mm is given

bottom_limit_mm.description: The lowest cleat keeps its underside this far above the floor (default 210)

buffer_mm.description: Buffer between hangers and above the floor (default 30)

gap_mm.description: Gap between cleat boards (default = board_mm, as in the Fredenslund system); pitch = board + gap

hook_plate_mm.description: Hook plate incl. material (default 72); at most the gap − 3, so a hanger can be lifted off

table_height_mm.description: Table height — the top of the table (default 900). The table hangs on a cleat table_offset_mm lower, and that cleat anchors the rows

table_offset_mm.description: How far below the table height the table's own cleat has its top edge (default 60 = hook plate − material, so the tabletop hangs like a hanger; 0 makes the table height the top of a cleat)

tip_trim_mm.description: Tip trim taken off the 45° bevel (default 1); changes finished sizes only

top_clearance_mm.description: Clearance below the ceiling (default = the gap, 90); at least the hook plate + 3, so a hanger on the top row can be lifted off

wall_height_mm.description: Wall height in mm (300–4000, default 2440 — a full plywood sheet)

wall_width_mm.description: Wall width in mm (200–8000, default 1220 — a full plywood sheet)
